name: Naga
source: A member of Sala's entourage, a swordswoman and DRAGON. She pilots the mecha called Ryu-Shing-Ki Soryugo. She respects and is deeply in love with Salamandinay, to the point where she will become hostile if somebody tries to do something to her dear Sala.
